prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-05):
| Return 3m            | +16.8% |
| Return 1m            | +14.5% |
| Return 1w            | +4.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 94% |
| 21d realized vol     | 22% |
| Last close           | 179.23 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown strong uptrends in the near term (3m +16.8%, 1m +14.5%), with positive weekly momentum and a solid realized vol level, suggesting continued strength over a ~20-trading-day horizon. However, its range position at 94% indicates it is near the upper end of its recent range, implying some near-term risk of a mean-reversion pullback if momentum stalls.

DECISION: BUY
